readOnlyRoutes.reason: Adds one private evidence-only GET route with strict session revocation, bounded rate limiting, server-resolved tenant and principal identity, explicit private no-store caching, no query parameters and no mutating method exports. Updated for roadmap 7.1.3 (multi-tenant #20): this GET now passes its request to resolveTenantPrincipalContext, so a bound white-label host resolves to that tenant instead of falling through to the platform default. A host naming no bound domain asserts nothing and the route resolves exactly as before. The only source change is request: req at the call site; no control changed, which is why this entry is re-pinned rather than rewritten.
